name.description:
Name of the layer. This is now being used to ensure that layers create unique Source ids.
The layer's index will be concatenated to this string to ensure uniqueness.

layerMarkers.description: Set of Markers included in this layer.

layerPolygonCoordinates.description: Coordinates to draw the layer polygons.

layerAttribute.description: String for attribute shared by all markers in this layer.

isOnByDefault.description: Whether or not the layer is displayed by default.

isSelected.description: Whether or not the layer is displayed.

isMultiLayerVisualizable.description: Whether or not the layer can be displayed with other layers.

opacity.description:
The opacity for the layer. Default is 0.3
Must be from 0 to 1

title: A type that represents a layer displayed on {@link UiSdlMap}.
name: UiSdlMapLayer
